The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: on this day.

notes: Combine directly with parts of the day: 'heute Morgen' (this morning), 'heute Nachmittag' (this afternoon), 'heute Abend' (this evening / tonight).

examples.emotion: cheerful and observant, enjoying the weather

senses.definition: At the present period of time, compared with the past.

examples.text: Heute reisen die Menschen viel mehr als früher.
examples.translation: Nowadays, people travel much more than in the past.

notes: While 'heute' means 'on this day', it can also be used in more general terms to mean 'nowadays' or 'in our time'.
It is common to use 'heute' at the start of a sentence for emphasis, which will shift the verb to the second position.
